prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the two frames of the HALCYON BULWARK lane laser emitter — a squat armoured cannon block pointing LEFT that charges and fires lane lasers.

Design identity to keep exactly — a clearly WIDER-THAN-TALL horizontal armoured cannon block, its body a broad slab about 1.8 times as wide as tall (never a square), with a flat muzzle face on its LEFT end: steel-blue armour body (#2e5082) with a lit top ramp (#4a78b0/#8ab8e8), dark under-plate (#1e3458), bold outline (#0a1428), and its muzzle dominated by a vertical cyan charge aperture (#38d8f8) set in the left face with a matching cyan power strip running down its body.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 cells laid out as 1 ROW OF 2 (2-column by 1-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE emitter; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the emitter IDLE: the cyan aperture dim and flat, just an open muzzle slit. The subject lies within aspect 1.40:1 to 2.30:1.
  cell 2 = the SAME emitter CHARGED: the aperture and strip flaring hot white-cyan (#e8ffff cores with #38d8f8 halos) — ready to fire, armour unchanged. The subject lies within aspect 1.40:1 to 2.30:1.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 576×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge

notes:
bosses/bulwark-emitter (2f 27×15 served; lane laser emitter pointing left, frame 1 glows; armour) — the 2 cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell; state xors 80% over the interim animation floor 0.4%. The design carries its own 1-px outline, so the outline pass is off.
